{{Quote|Just what qualifications do you have&mdash;outside of officiousness, boorishness, and misguided snobbery&mdash; for any duty whatsoever?|[[Plif/Legends|Plif]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 77">[[Star Wars (1977) 77|''Star Wars'' (1977) 77]]</ref>}}
This '''doorman''' was employed at [[Kabray Station]], where he announced incoming delegates that frequented the high class [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. He had two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] at his disposal, and they assisted him in keeping out uninvited guests.

==Biography==
When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] attempted to infiltrate the station to search for a message that had been left there by [[Tay Vanis]], they were stopped by the doorman who demanded identification. Since the two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] were posing as aides to [[Plif/Legends|Plif]], the delegate from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]], the [[Hoojib/Legends|Hoojib]] began to scold the doorman for his poor manners. After claiming that he had been invited, Plif threatened to tell the [[Unidentified Imperial Governor (Kabray)|Imperial Governor]] of the doorman's behavior. Taken aback at the verbal thrashing, the doorman let them pass.
